The **best DonorPerfect alternatives** most often cited are **Donorbox, Bloomerang, Givebutter, Neon CRM, and Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT**.[1][4] If you want a shortlist for most nonprofits, **Donorbox** is frequently positioned as the strongest overall alternative for a more donor-friendly giving experience, while **Bloomerang** and **Givebutter** are commonly highlighted for ease of use and fundraising/CRM simplicity.[1][4][7]

A practical way to choose is by nonprofit size and priorities:

| Alternative | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Donorbox** | Small to mid-sized nonprofits | User-friendly donor experience, recurring donations, and CRM features.[1] |
| **Bloomerang** | Donor retention and relationship management | Strong donor data and relationship-focused CRM.[4][7] |
| **Givebutter** | Modern fundraising campaigns | Easy-to-use all-in-one fundraising and CRM platform.[4] |
| **Neon CRM** | Broader nonprofit CRM needs | Listed among top alternatives and positioned as a full CRM option.[1] |
| **Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT** | Larger organizations | Scalable, enterprise-grade constituent management.[1][4] |

If your main goal is **lower cost**, **Jotform** is explicitly described as a more cost-effective alternative in a DonorPerfect comparison article.[2] If your focus is **retention**, Funraise says it is widely seen as a stronger alternative in that area.[3]
